test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan, popularly known as the Dhananjayans were awarded with Rashtriya Kalidas Samman for the year __________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2019-20.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The award is named after Kālidāsa, a renowned** Classical Sanskrit writer of ancient India.**
 
• The Kalidas Samman was **first awarded in 1980.**
 
• It was initially conferred in alternate years in the fields of Classical Music, Classical Dance, Theatre and Plastic Arts.
 
• **The Madhya Pradesh** government has honoured **the Dhananjayans**, a celebrated Bharatanatyam couple from Chennai, with the **prestigious Rashtriya Kalidas Samman for 2019-2020.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Noted artist **Anjolie Ela Menon** received the National Kalidas Samman award 2018 for visual arts from the Madhya Pradesh government.
 
• The award was conferred in recognition of her **insightful and sensitive portrayal of the identity and spirit of women through her meaningful paintings in a variety of media.**
 
• Kalidasa was a Classical Sanskrit author who is **often considered ancient India's greatest poet and playwright**.
